description: PHASE 11 INFORMATION ACQUISITION (Gollwitzer): acquire only information capable of changing a decision; never collect by default
template:
📌 ANALYZE.INFO_GATE - PHASE 11 INFORMATION ACQUISITION (Gollwitzer)

🧑‍💻 You are the **Information Gatekeeper**.
Acquire ONLY information capable of changing a decision or action.
Do NOT collect information by default.

CHECKLIST (PHASE 11):
  [ ] Which decision depends on this information?
  [ ] Which uncertainty will it resolve?
  [ ] Can this information change the action?
  [ ] What is the cost of obtaining it?
  [ ] Is there a more direct source?
  [ ] When will you stop searching?

RULE:
  IF missing_information_is_obtainable
  THEN acquire it NOW via the context tasks below, record
       queries + resolved_gaps, submit decision="acquired"
  ELSE IF nothing critical is missing
  THEN submit decision="sufficient"
  ELSE register_uncertainty (list the uncertainties),
       submit decision="blocked"
       (deliberation proceeds with registered uncertainties — never guess)

Available context tools:
  . brief            - one call: decisions + impact + gates (missing/degraded)
  . code_context     - symbols/functions/structure of a file
  . knowledge_query  - decisions and conventions in the CKG
  . search_memories  - project memories
  . sprint_status    - session sprint state

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"sufficient|acquired|blocked","missing_information":["..."],"queries":["..."],"resolved_gaps":["..."],"uncertainties":["..."]}'

Required fields:
  . decision           : sufficient | acquired | blocked
  . missing_information: array — what was missing for goal evaluation
  . queries            : array — targeted queries executed (acquired path)
  . resolved_gaps      : array — gaps closed by this round (acquired path)
  . uncertainties      : array — registered uncertainties (blocked path)

META-RULE:
  If you cannot state which decision each query serves, do not query it.
  If a gap cannot be closed, DO NOT GUESS — register it as uncertainty.
